expect_return_s.description:
Expected seconds until the session's next request (a tool pause). Caps the floor at that return plus a
short grace period.

ttl_s.description:
Seconds the session's KV should stay at least in host RAM, renewed by every request: the contract term
(300 for a 5-minute Anthropic `cache_control` TTL). 0 means no floor, which is plain LRU.

oneOf.description: Drop the session's floor at once (the session closed); its KV falls back to LRU.

SessionId.description: One conversation, scoped to a tenant: 1 to 128 characters from [A-Za-z0-9._:-].

SloClass.description: The SLO class of a request: which clock it runs on. Classes order from strictest to most lenient.

oneOf.description: Voice turns. Never rejected: admission makes room, then degrades the reply.
Agent loops with a person waiting. Predicted-TTFT admission; queued with a deadline.

Batch agents, trace replays, memory consolidation. Best effort with a minimum share; deferred or demoted
whenever realtime needs room.
